headline: Gold prices fall for fifth consecutive session to multi-month low
summary: Gold prices extended losses for a fifth consecutive trading session, touching 15-month lows in Vietnam and multi-month bottoms globally as safe-haven demand shifted and yields fluctuated.
why: Gold is a primary global precious metal commodity held as an inflation hedge and store of value by central banks and private investors.

impacts.name: Gold Futures
impacts.why: Gold futures declined for a fifth straight session, reaching multi-month lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent selling pressure and broader financial market liquidation pushed gold prices down for a fifth session.
